title: Velvet type fabric and method of producing same
abstract: A velvet fabric with a weft and warp foundation incorporating cut pile threads made from synthetic resin material like nylon. The pile threads have hook-shaped ends that serve as material-engaging means, enabling two pieces to interlock and adhere when pressed together, then separate when pulled apart.
gist: Hook-and-loop fastening: nylon pile threads are woven into loops over heated bars, then cut so each loop leaves a tiny hook. Two pieces grip each other when pressed and peel apart when pulled — a reusable fastener without buttons or zips.
